verdict.rationale: ADK explicitly documents a Tool Confirmation flow described as HITL that guards tool execution with explicit confirmation and custom input, plus a Workflow Runtime and Task API that both explicitly list human-in-the-loop support alongside state management, retries, and pause/resume-style constructs (fan-out/fan-in, multi-turn task mode). This directly supports pausing mid-run for human approval and resuming with the human's decision. Missing for 10: a first-party docs walkthrough (not just README bullet points) showing the full pause/resume code flow and independent hands-on confirmation of the resume behavior.
